sources.articleTitle: Eldoret elevated to Metropolitan Archdiocese as Pope appoints Obanyi first Archbishop
Bishop Obanyi appointed first Metropolitan Archbishop of New Eldoret Archdiocese

headline: Pope Francis Names Bishop Obanyi As Archbishop Of Eldoret Province
seoTitle: Bishop Obanyi Appointed Archbishop of Eldoret
metaDescription: Pope Francis has elevated Eldoret to a Metropolitan Archdiocese, appointing Bishop Obanyi as the first Metropolitan Archbishop of the new province.
aiSummaryBullets: Pope Francis has formally elevated the Diocese of Eldoret to the status of a Metropolitan Archdiocese.
Bishop Obanyi has been named as the inaugural Metropolitan Archbishop to lead the newly created ecclesiastical province.
The new Metropolitan Province includes the Archdiocese of Eldoret along with suffragan dioceses in Lodwar, Kapsabet, Kitale, and Kericho.
aiContextParagraph: The Catholic Church in Kenya has undergone an administrative restructuring following an announcement from the Vatican. Pope Francis has designated the Diocese of Eldoret as a new Metropolitan Archdiocese, effectively creating a new Metropolitan Province within the country's ecclesiastical framework. Alongside this change in status, Bishop Obanyi has been appointed to serve as the first Metropolitan Archbishop for this region. This structural reorganization groups the central Archdiocese of Eldoret with four surrounding suffragan dioceses, which include Lodwar, Kapsabet, Kitale, and Kericho. These administrative updates are part of the broader governance of the Catholic Church in Kenya, establishing a new hierarchical province to oversee these specific diocesan jurisdictions. The announcement confirms the official transition of Eldoret and the formal placement of its new leadership under the established religious mandates of the Holy See.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained moderate traction through religious and local media outlets following the official Vatican announcement regarding ecclesiastical changes.
